title: MIDAS: Mosaic Input-Specific Differentiable Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2602.17700v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Differentiable Neural Architecture Search (NAS) provides efficient, gradient-based methods for automatically designing neural networks, yet its adoption remains limited in practice. We present MIDAS, an approach that modernizes DARTS by replacing static architecture parameters with dynamic, input-specific parameters computed via self-attention. To improve robustness, MIDAS (i) localizes the architecture selection by computing it separately for each spatial patch of the activation map, and (ii) introduces a parameter-free, topology-aware search space that models the two-edge node topology during search. We evaluate MIDAS on the DARTS, NAS-Bench-201, and RDARTS search spaces. In DARTS, it reaches 97.42% top-1 on CIFAR-10 and 83.38% on CIFAR-100. In NAS-Bench-201, it discovers optimal or near-optimal architectures. In RDARTS, it achieves the best reported performance among the compared methods on two of four search spaces on CIFAR

translated_title: MIDAS：马赛克式输入特定可微架构搜索
translated_abstract: 可微分神经架构搜索（NAS）为自动设计神经网络提供了高效的、基于梯度的方法，但其在实际中的应用仍然有限。我们提出了MIDAS，该方法通过用经由自注意力机制计算的动态、输入特定参数取代静态架构参数，使DARTS实现现代化。为了提高鲁棒性，MIDAS（i）通过为激活图的每个空间补丁单独计算架构选择，实现了架构选择的局部化；（ii）引入了一个无参数的、拓扑感知的搜索空间，该空间在搜索过程中对双边节点拓扑进行建模。我们在DARTS、NAS-Bench-201和RDARTS搜索空间上评估了MIDAS。在DARTS搜索空间上，它在CIFAR-10上达到97.42%的top-1准确率，在CIFAR-100上达到83.38%。在NAS-Bench-201上，它发现了最优或接近最优的架构。在RDARTS上，它在CIFAR数据集四个搜索空间中的两个上取得了所比较方法中已报道的最佳性能。
tldr: MIDAS通过自注意力机制为每个输入动态计算架构参数，并结合逐补丁的局部化架构选择与无参数的拓扑感知搜索空间，对DARTS进行现代化改进，在DARTS、NAS-Bench-201和RDARTS等多个基准上取得了优异性能。
